title: hive-bench hard tier — CPU-routing vs LLM-everything, n=15

inspired_by.pattern: GLM-5.3-style benchmark card + SWE-bench held-out grading

official_score.authority: none — no sealed external score; the artifact IS the record
official_score.note: resolve_rate is the local metric; there is no organizer-sealed analog

local_metric.name: resolve_rate
local_metric.formula: resolved_episodes / total_episodes, per arm; resolved = hidden oracle pytest passes on the agent's replayed patch

secondary.mean_llm_calls: LLM invocations per episode — the routing-cost metric
secondary.usd_total: endpoint-reported cost across all episodes in the arm

gate_deviations.historical_run_state: at the kept run (commit 79a24c7) oracle/tests/* were git-tracked and oracle/solution.patch was untracked + gitignored
gate_deviations.current_repository_state: oracle/tests/* and oracle/solution.patch are both git-tracked — task.json references the patch and --verify-tasks/CI need it in a fresh clone
gate_deviations.reason: a model trained on this repo may have seen the hidden tests and the gold patch — absolute resolve rates are contaminated. The routing/cost delta is less exposed (memorizing a solution does not change which transitions are mechanical) but is not proven immune: a memorized fix can shorten the mechanical prefix the policy routes.

gates.smoke_red_on_pristine: required — visible suite must fail on the buggy repo (reproduction signal)
gates.smoke_green_after_patch: required — visible suite must pass under solution.patch
gates.oracle_green_after_patch: required — hidden oracle must pass under solution.patch
gates.oracle_absent_from_agent_workdir: required — repo/ ships no tests/; hidden tests never in the agent's workdir (oracle/ files themselves are git-tracked)
gates.pytest_control_blocked: conftest.py/pytest.ini/sitecustomize.py writes rejected in write_file + grade_patch

superseded — the spec note fired only for hive's policy, so hive-vs-baseline was not a clean routing contrast; also n=5 noise band ±2-3/5
superseded — predates the equalized spec review, the conftest gate, the vacuous-smoke fix, and the smoke_note prompt truth fix

runs.change: definitive n=15 run on suite.hard.json, spec review equalized across all arms
runs.mcnemar: all pairs not_separable (p=1.0, zero discordant tasks)

flagged_runs.reason: two tasks were undisclosed-rule traps — all three arms failed the same oracle test (lru-ttl sweep, snapshot negative-coverage) that the problem_statement never disclosed; the 0/5s measured mind-reading, not capability. Tell: the all-arms-common-fail sweep replayed every patch and found one oracle test failing for ALL arms.

the spec-carrying escalation fired only for hive's RuleBasedRoutingPolicy (reason 'verify green'); baseline/context never got the post-green spec re-check, so the routing delta was confounded by a prompt advantage. Tell: escalation_note only constructed under `if uses_hive:` and gated on a prose reason string.

hive's early 0/5 on sliding-window-limit was initially read as a routing deficiency; the real cause was a vacuous smoke test (one key, <=1 trivially passes) that never taught the eviction rule, plus a stale smoke_note telling agents the suite 'is NOT the criterion'. Tell: the smoke test passed on the buggy repo.

closed_levers.detail: oracle tests asserting behavior the problem_statement never states (lru-ttl sweep, snapshot negative-coverage) produce 0/5 for every arm and zero separation — a mind-read tax, not difficulty. Closed by disclosing the rule in the statement + smoke, or dropping the oracle test.
a smoke test that passes on the buggy repo teaches nothing (sliding-window quiet-keys used one key, <=1 trivially true). Closed by making smoke assert the real invariant (two-key case, ==1).
delivering the post-green spec re-check only to hive's policy confounds the routing contrast. Closed by a finish-intercept that gives every arm one identical spec-review turn before finishing.
conftest.py/pytest.ini/sitecustomize.py can deselect or skip oracle tests without fixing source. Closed by a basename blocklist in write_file + grade_patch.
at 5 repeats, temp 0.7, per-cell rates swing ±2-3/5 with no intervention (context moved 0→3/5 on unchanged prompts). Closed by n=15 for any per-task claim.

do_not: equate resolve_rate with a sealed external score — there is none; this is the local record
restate capability4/capability5/discriminating numbers as current — all three are superseded by hard-tier-final

cite absolute resolve rates as capability evidence for a model that has seen this repo — oracle/tests/ and oracle/solution.patch are public (oracle_public_in_git recorded per run); the routing/cost delta is less exposed but not proven immune
read hive's 3.04-vs-7.2 call delta as a learned-policy result — the arm runs the rule-based state machine, not the trained CPURouterPolicy
